conditions.displayName: A budget_exhausted refusal or a mid-generation provider credit exhaustion was logged

conditionMatchedLog.filter: log_id("docker") AND ((jsonPayload.msg="request" AND jsonPayload.error="budget_exhausted") OR (jsonPayload.scope="run" AND jsonPayload.msg="provider credit exhausted"))

documentation.content: Whim's own OpenRouter credit is exhausted: generate, clarify and rewrite are refusing (or ending) with `budget_exhausted`. At most one email per hour: check the balance at https://openrouter.ai/credits and top up, then see docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts.
